items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: And the trumpets we had from time to time was Joe Oliver

ctx.x: In Bay St. Louis, Mississippi. And the trumpets we had from time to time was Joe Oliver, Tom McCary, Ernest Punch Miller, Sidney Parris, Junior, he's called Gabriel, Louis Armstrong.
